messages.text:
Interview feedback for Qi.

There are a few flags listed below, and I won't pretend they're not there. But honestly, I have a good feeling about this person. I think she'd be an asset. She's confident and practical, and once she settles in, I think it really shows. We need the next rounds to confirm it, and a conversation with Valentina in particular feels vital to help steer us right.

Flags
• Some language/communication friction came up at times
• Quite reserved and may take time to match the energy of our environment
• Read from notes for her bio, though handled probing questions confidently and off the cuff
• Some concern around how assertively she'll get ideas across in practice
Positives
• Knows her stuff and answered off-the-cuff questions really well
• Practical and pragmatic, doesn't reach for complexity unless it's needed, but clearly can go there
• Good instincts around handling pushback and separating concerns
Next steps
• Technical test to probe depth
• Conversation with Hrusi
• Conversation with Valentina (think this one's key)
• Circle back after those rounds

messages.text:
My gut is leaning no on this one. He seems sharp and knows his area well, but I'm not convinced the experience is a strong enough match for what we need. There's a small part of me that wonders if a second conversation could change things. Skill is there, the match just isn't quite right.
Flags
• Experience skews more toward data analytics than modeling, recommendation engines and the kind of work we're doing
• Bloomberg and other experience is decent but doesn't feel as well-rounded as other candidates
• Has worked with journalists which I love, but didn't lean into that at all given what we're building
• Struggled with some questions more than other candidates, even with added context and elaboration
• Limited exposure to language models and neural networks, which isn't a dealbreaker but others have had some and he has none
Positives
• Sharp and thoughtful, what he knows he knows well
• Personality-wise he'd fit here, no concerns there
• I don't doubt his skill set at all, just the fit
Verdict
• Instinct is to pass, but open to a second conversation if others feel differently
